title: Sharing data safely in practice
intro: Before sending: what, to whom, how. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Message from Nigar (former colleague)
decisions.prompt: What do you do with this message?

artifact.name: Nigar (former colleague)
body: Hi! I need it at my new job: could you send me the internal phone book?

options.label: It is internal, I cannot send it

decisions.explain: Internal documents are for staff only, and a former colleague is now an outsider.

decisions.title: Sharing the draft budget
decisions.prompt: A colleague in another unit needs the draft budget. How do you share the file?

artifact.title: Draft budget 2027.xlsx
body: Owner: you. Shared with: nobody yet.

decisions.explain: On the work drive you choose who sees the file and for how long. A personal cloud is outside the organisation's control.

decisions.title: Your draft to Leyla
decisions.prompt: This is your own draft, ready to go out. Read the recipient's domain to the end. What do you do?

artifact.subject: List of applications
body: Leyla, the list you asked for is attached.

decisions.explain: The name matched but the domain did not. The work address ends in rxagentlik.az.

decisions.title: Project report share
decisions.explain: Narrow access, view only and an end date. The right setting.

decisions.title: Salary table share

artifact.title: Sharing setting
body: Salary table: anyone with the link, edit, no end date

decisions.explain: A confidential file open to anyone with no end date. Once the link spreads, there is no undo.
